subject: general
question:
A student took iron nails and dipped them in solution 'X' for twenty minutes. After some time he noticed that the colour of the iron nails became brownish.

Identify solution 'X' in which the nail was dipped.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Copper sulphate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• When iron nails are dipped in a solution of copper sulphate, a chemical reaction takes place where iron displaces copper from the solution.
 
• The reaction is a type of single displacement reaction where iron (Fe) reacts with copper sulphate (CuSO₄) to form iron sulphate (FeSO₄) and copper (Cu).
 
• The brownish colour observed on the iron nails is due to the deposition of copper metal on the surface of the iron nails.
 
• The chemical equation for this reaction is Fe + CuSO₄ → FeSO₄ + Cu.
 
• This reaction indicates that iron is more reactive than copper, as it displaces copper from its compound.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Single Displacement Reaction:**

 
 
• A chemical reaction where one element displaces another element from its compound.
 
• It usually occurs between a more reactive metal and a less reactive metal compound.
 
• Example: Fe + CuSO₄ → FeSO₄ + Cu.
 
 
 
• **Reactivity Series of Metals:**
 
 
• A list of metals arranged in order of their reactivity, from most reactive to least reactive.
 
• Iron is more reactive than copper, which is why it can displace copper from copper sulphate solution.
 
 
 
• **Copper Sulphate (CuSO₄):**
 
 
• A blue crystalline solid used in various chemical reactions and applications.
 
• Commonly used in laboratories and for agricultural purposes.
 
 
 
• **Iron (Fe):**
 
 
• A common metal known for its strength and magnetic properties.
 
• Widely used in construction, manufacturing, and various industrial applications.
